blocks.text: Leafbook carries a folded leaf inside thick pages. It is a compact care object, not a readable copy of the Codex. Its form lets an everyday name coexist with a longer account in the lore book.
An impossible small pale blue folded stone book with no words, copper leaf caught in its angular hollow.
One-shot activation: Stone pages part and the copper leaf unfolds into a wide curved fan. The game performs the final fade.
48 silver. Clears Digestion / Parasites. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.

Original PixelLab artwork and opening animation, October 28, 2026. Generation 91ce9896-b853-4332-a04a-75cd19100081; animation c85c3691-cff3-4fa7-b088-5cf38c2b9987. The game performs the final fade; reduced motion holds a still.
